game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the frost mage must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the cases value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the hearth fire using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the hearth fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Hearth Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Hearth Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 20.
